  \caption[{\(V_{\mathrm{DDDAC}}\) against time over five process corners, \texttt{PSUStartupTB}: \texttt{En} rises at\,\dots}]{\(V_{\mathrm{DDDAC}}\) against time over five process corners, \texttt{PSUStartupTB}: \texttt{En} rises at \SI{50}{\micro\second} into a \SI{500}{\micro\second} window at zero external load, \SI{27}{\celsius} at point 1 and \SI{25}{\celsius} at points 2--5.
